title: Bearframe RPG uses 32x32 world tiles; older 48px World Editor format is separate
summary: Current Founder-selected Bearframe RPG terrain/collision grid is 32x32; purchased/collected tile assets must not be resized to 48px. A historical 384x768 sheet with 48px cells belongs to a separate World Editor v1 legacy contract and must not override this engine. Sprite frames may be taller than collision cells.
